# browserbuddy serve

Run the MCP stdio server and the WebSocket hub. Only the WebSocket carrier uses this: with the extension's default native transport the browser spawns the host itself (see install-host).

## Flags

| Name | Short | Type | Default | Env | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--port` |  | int | 8590 |  | WebSocket hub port on 127.0.0.1. Must match WS_URL in extension/background.js, which only applies when that file sets TRANSPORT to websocket. |
| `--data-dir` |  | str |  |  | Directory for event logs and recorded demonstrations. Defaults to server/data inside the installed package. |
